messages:
daria: PartnerCloud Ops asked for an "airgapped marketplace" demo using our terraform starter and image import flow. They want a 30-45m session next Thurs.

lee: propose 40m: 10m architecture + creds, 20m run terraform + import, 10m smoke tests. I'll prep a minimal lab repo.

sam: note: our starter expects outbound 443 for license check; add an offline license file option and instructions to seed the KMS certs.

ci-bot: CI: terraform/starter-kit #905 passed  plan ok. (https://ci.redwood.dev/905)

lee: added `presets/airgap.tfvars` and a short `README-airgap.md` with docker save/load steps: `docker pull redwood/llm-runtime:2026-05 && docker save -o runtime.tar redwood/llm-runtime:2026-05` then scp to target.

daria: great. include a kernel version note (we recommend linux-5.15+) and a tip to disable `kv_prefetch` on older kernels.

sam: added `--allow-local-license` flag in examples for the lab only; default remains cloud-checks. documented rollback steps if model fails to load.

anna: legal asked about rebranding the labs. repo is MIT; ok to rebrand but keep attribution and LICENSE file.

daria: perfect. can we do a quick dry run Mon 2pm PT? owners: lee (lab), sam (modules), anna (legal blurb).

lee: yep, i'll push the invite and link to the repo. :thumbsup:
